summary: AmeriServ Financial filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results and declaring a routine quarterly dividend. Q3 net income was $3.1M, or $0.18 per diluted share, up 21.9% from $2.544M ($0.15) a year earlier; nine-month net income was $7.632M ($0.45), an 80.0% EPS increase. The board declared a $0.03 per share quarterly cash dividend payable November 16, 2026 to holders of record November 2, 2026. No transaction, advisor, or structural mechanics are present; the filing is ordinary earnings and capital-return disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
